Build comparison: the twelve changes, before and after

Branch claude/build-comparison-ux-d98b9e, 2026-10-09. Screenshots from published builds of the branch before (ff0226c) and after, with a copy of the Luca profile plus a weapon "Pairs" run in skill pair optimize mode on a saved sequence (Offset TCS), so the pair ranking, the pair headings and sequence names show. The numbers on each picture are the items of notes/build-comparison-changes.md:

  1. Pair ranking vs #1 in percent (Best as damage)
  2. No damage per minute
  3. Hits and MV behind an (i)
  4. Compare tab row order, skill and bonus lists, empty slots
  5. Named, saved sequences as chips
  6. No Procs row in Compare
  7. Compare all per pair, 20 builds, sideways scrolling
  8. Bigger collapse toggles
  9. Results always sorted by damage
  10. Card titles level with the header buttons
  11. Compare with / View in the pair heading
  12. Talisman slot icons and button groups

Results

591011 The scored-on line names the sequence as a chip (Offset TCS, its steps and target under the (i)). Compare with, View and Sort leave the card: Sort is gone (builds always sort by damage), the other two move into the first pair heading. The title sits level with the buttons.

1 Best is the pair's best damage, and vs #1 how far behind the first pair it is, in percent (±0.0% for a tie).

711 The pair heading keeps rank and pair (the solver details are in a tooltip on #1), with Compare with, View and Compare all on its right. No Per minute column.

2 Current's results table: the Per minute column is gone.

235 A build card: no per-minute next to the damage; the MV of each hit sits behind an (i); the footnote names the sequence as a chip.

25 The card's stats: Damage per sequence only, Scored on as a chip.

810 Results collapsed: a bigger chevron, and the title level with Run again / Download / Copy.

Compare tab

34567 After: Compare all on pair #1 (the Compare with build becomes the baseline). Rows: Damage (the sequence as a chip), Stats (no Procs row), each build's skills and its set bonuses / group skills (differences opened), Equipment with Available empty slots, What it takes, Damage per attack last with hits and MV behind the (i). No Per minute row. Before: five builds ticked one by one.

4 Skills: each build's list first, then the row that opens the differences below it. Before, the opener sat in the section heading.

4 Set bonuses and group skills, the same way. Before, the long names in the row heads spilled over the first column and hid its values; now they wrap.

7 After only: Compare all on all three pairs, 16 builds (the limit is 20). Columns keep a minimum width.

7 After only: the same, scrolled sideways and down: row heads stay on the left, column heads on top.

7 After only: the tray at the bottom of other tabs with 16 builds on one line that scrolls sideways.

My builds

235 Damage per attack: Hits, MV and Per minute columns go; the bars now compare the damage within each group; the (i) gives kind, hits and MV; the user's own sequence shows by its saved name (chip with its steps).

Conditions

25 The attack picker lists saved sequences (Your sequences) and shows the current one by name; the editor loads saved sequences or examples, and shows the name with Rename / Delete, or Save as… for an unsaved one. The Landed hits per minute input is gone (as you decided), and the summary line no longer mentions per minute.

5 After only: Current picking the saved Offset TCS from the attack picker.

5 After only: Rename opens a name dialog (Save as… uses the same one).

Talismans

12 Every slot square has the game's mark in its corner: the helmet for an armor slot, the sword for a weapon slot.

12 Editing a talisman: one row per slot with weapon / armor and × 1 2 3 instead of the dropdown. Slots keep the game's order; choices that make a layout random talismans do not roll are greyed out (here: no weapon slot next to armor 2 + 1, no level 3).

12 The same editor at phone width.

Inventory

5 The head to head names the scored sequence as a chip instead of the whole step list.
